quest.title: The Gourmet Supremos: The Seashore Strider
quest.description: You once again encounter the Gourmet Supremos near Inazuma's beaches...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Recipe: Crab Roe Kourayaki x1, Delicious Crab Roe Kourayaki x3, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: This dish certainly does have a very "Julie"-esque feel to it.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: In fact, the first time I saw it, I thought it must've come from Mondstadt. But as it turns out, it's a local specialty instead.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: I bet it tastes just as good as its name sounds, Xudong! C'mon, let's make some, please!

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Oh, it's you, Traveler! Hehe, see, what did I tell you about us meeting again?

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Xudong's picked up a new recipe from the city! It's called Crab Roe Kourayaki. Pretty good name, huh?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: It's not that hard to make either. But it does require a great number of crabs...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: I've prepared some normal crabs, and now I'm looking for some... special ones.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Special crabs?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Exactly! In specific, we're going for the ones that dwell under that Thunder Sakura!

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: You might as well say "thunderstruck crabs"...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Well, I'm just curious, you know? I wonder what crabs that live under such circumstances will taste like...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: However, with lightning flashing all around that tree, I daren't get too close.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: My book states that just like before, you just need to touch a Thunder Sakura Bough and cause an Electrogranum to attach to you...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: And that way, you won't be struck by the lightning from the Thunder Sakura.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: But well, you've seen what that tree looks like. I'm not going to risk it based off such a rough summary of a solution.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Wouldn't it work if we just ran fast enough?

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Are you daft? Do you think you can run faster than lightning!?

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Well, why don't we just use a stick to pull those crabs out and stuff...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: If you ask me, we might as well dig some ditch nearby. That'll draw both the water and the crabs out.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Hahaha. Everyone's got their own opinion. That's great, that's great!

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: If you don't mind, Traveler, could you help us catch a few of the crabs that live under that Thunder Sakura?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: If you do, I'll whip up a great feast for you as thanks.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Ah, yes. Hang on... Take this bait.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: If you're going to catch crabs over there, use these to attract them first.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: It should save you some time and effort.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Crabs that live near a Thunder Sakura. I wonder how they'll taste...

choices.text: Oh, we're talking about delicious food again, are we?

talks.objective: Place bait near the Thunder Sakura

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: That book of mine says that if you touch the Thunder Sakura Bough, you won't be hit by any of those lightning bolts around the Thunder Sakura...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: But well, you've seen what that tree looks like. I'm not going to risk it based off such a rough summary of a solution.

talks.objective: Catch crabs near the Thunder Sakura

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler! How goes the crab-catching harvest?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Oho! This crab looks pretty good. You're a dab hand at this, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Well then, since we've got all our ingredients, let's begin cooking post-haste.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Let me prepare for a while, Traveler. Please wait here.

talks.objective: Give the captured crab to Xudong

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Kourayaki... Why is it called Kourayaki, I wonder...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Well, guess we'll make it first and ask questions later.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Aha, here we go! "Crab Roe Kourayaki."

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: I'll have one! Mm-hmm, this is great!

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Give me one of the smaller ones. I doubt I'd be able to finish one that's too large...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: And this serving's for you, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Here, why don't you have a copy of the recipe, too?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: This dish shouldn't be too hard to make, so you can try it yourself if you like.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: We'll probably head for the vicinity of <color=#00E1FFFF>Yashiori Island</color> next. Go look for us there, if you've got the time.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Alright, time to grab a bite for myself, eh...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Hey! Julie! Leave one for me!

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Why do Electrograna have so many uses... how strange...

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: I wonder how this Crab Roe Kourayaki is going to taste...

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: I wonder if there are any tougher branches nearby...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Hmm, perhaps digging a ditch might take a little too long...
